title: feat: move official agents to pollinations-ai
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Moving Floret, MIDI Journey, and Polli from Elliot's `pollinations-router` account to `pollinations-ai` changes their callable model IDs while preserving their listing UUIDs and historical records. As agreed for this beta, the old names will stop resolving after transfer; callers must use the new names.

- Allows the destination GitHub account to publish community models.
- Updates Pollinations-owned Polli workflows and the Floret example to the new names.
- Adds deferred, guarded D1 scripts to copy the provider profile, transfer only the three existing listings, and rewrite exact old API-key model scopes. Normal deployment does not run these scripts.
- Tests the canonical-name switch, restricted-key catalog behavior, workflow routing, and D1 transfer and scope-rewrite safety.

Rollout after review: merge to `main`, promote through the separate `production` PR, verify the publisher allowlist is live, then run the owner transfer followed immediately by the key-scope rewrite. Workflows merged to `main` may fail until the D1 transfer. No production data has changed.

Local validation: focused Gen and Enter D1 tests, Polli workflow tests, Biome, and Enter/Gen typechecks passed. Both staging workers deployed and returned HTTP 200. The authenticated staging check was explicitly waived for this PR.

gist.headline: Three agents change gardens
gist.blurb: Floret, MIDI Journey, and Polli are moving to the pollinations-ai account. Their listing histories come along; after the transfer, callers will need their new model names.
gist.summary: Added pollinations-ai as a community-model publisher and prepared guarded D1 scripts to transfer Floret, MIDI Journey, and Polli from pollinations-router while preserving listing UUIDs and rewriting exact API-key model scopes.
gist.impact: After the separate production rollout and D1 transfer, callers will use pollinations-ai model IDs instead of pollinations-router IDs; existing listings and historical records remain intact.
gist.visual_concept: Depict three recognizable agent stations moving into a garden labeled pollinations-ai: a flower for Floret, musical notes for MIDI Journey, and a chat terminal for Polli. Polli the bee carries a tiny moving box while the CRT robot carefully carries a ledger representing preserved listing history.
